# Waivers for the Malicious Code Scan.
#
# One waiver per line:
#
#     <check-id> <path>
#
# The path is exactly as it appears in the scan output. A waiver silences that
# one check for that one file; it does not disable anything else.
#
# Waivers are keyed by file rather than by line so they survive code moving
# around, and they live in a tracked file so adding one shows up in review —
# turning off a security check should cost a conversation, not a quiet edit.
# The scan flags its own allowlist when it changes, for the same reason.
#
# Check ids:
#
#   key-material-sink    key material passed to a logger, formatter or socket
#   dynamic-exec         code evaluated at runtime
#   shell-exec           a shell is spawned
#   unexpected-egress    a request to a host outside the known set
#   pull-request-target  a workflow trigger that exposes repository secrets
#   workflow-expression  event data interpolated into a workflow
#   unpinned-action      an action pinned to a moving branch
#   workflow-changed     any change under .github/workflows
#   stellar-secret-seed  a Stellar secret seed
#   aws-access-key       an AWS access key id
#   github-token         a GitHub personal access token
#   pem-private-key      a PEM private key header
#
# From the installed-package scan, where the subject is a path inside
# node_modules rather than a tracked file:
#
#   install-hook         a dependency runs a script on npm install
#   exfil-endpoint       a request-capture or chat-webhook URL
#   credential-harvest   reads credential stores or serialises the environment
#   address-swap         overrides a network primitive or embeds wallet addresses
#
# Example:
#
#   pem-private-key internal/rpc/logger.go

# The log-sanitisation tests assert that a Stellar seed gets masked, so they
# have to contain something shaped like one. Four literals remain in this file;
# commit 474075af moved other fixtures in this package to runtime construction,
# and these should follow, at which point this waiver can go.
stellar-secret-seed internal/rpc/logger_test.go

# The redaction code and the HSM guide both quote the PEM header on purpose.
pem-private-key internal/rpc/logger.go
pem-private-key docs/HSM_INTEGRATION.md
